blocks.zh: Section 5: Conclusions, References & Appendices | 結論、參考文獻與附錄
blocks.en: Section 5: Conclusions, References & Appendices

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 TR-68 結論的核心主旨：患者保護、跨組織合作、以及風險為本的主動溝通三位一體，並能將全報告架構整合成系統性論述。
blocks.en: Understand the core message of the TR-68 conclusions: patient protection, cross-organizational collaboration, and risk-based proactive communication as a trinity, and be able to integrate the structure of the whole report into a systematic narrative.

blocks.zh: 熟悉 TR-68 引用的主要法規依據，包括 ICH Q9(R1)、ICH Q10、ICH Q12，以及 FDA、EMA 相關指引，了解其互補關係。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the main regulatory sources cited in TR-68, including ICH Q9(R1), ICH Q10, ICH Q12, and the relevant FDA and EMA guidance, and understand how they complement one another.

blocks.zh: 掌握附錄一「藥品短缺風險登記表」的欄位結構，能以 CDMO 情境填寫實際案例（如單一來源 API 注射劑）。
blocks.en: Master the field structure of Appendix 1, the Drug Shortage Risk Register, and be able to complete a real case from a CDMO perspective (e.g., a single-source API injectable).

blocks.zh: 掌握附錄二「藥品短缺預防與應對計畫」的五大組成部分（A–G），能依優先順序（1/2/3）連結相應的控制措施。
blocks.en: Master the five components (A-G) of Appendix 2, the Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan, and be able to link the corresponding control measures by priority (1/2/3).

blocks.zh: 了解 CDMO 如何主動運用 TR-68 框架，作為向 MAH 展示供應可靠性的競爭差異化工具。
blocks.en: Understand how a CDMO can proactively use the TR-68 framework as a competitive differentiator to demonstrate supply reliability to the MAH.

blocks.zh: 9.0 Conclusions | 結論
blocks.en: 9.0 Conclusions

blocks.zh: TR-68 整體框架的核心論點總結 • p38–p39
blocks.en: Summary of the Core Arguments of the TR-68 Framework • p38-p39

blocks.zh: 中文解析與學習重點
blocks.en: Commentary and Key Learning Points

blocks.zh: 三大核心主軸
blocks.en: Three Core Themes

blocks.zh: TR-68 結論呈現三個互相強化的主軸：
blocks.en: The TR-68 conclusions present three mutually reinforcing themes:

blocks.zh: 患者保護：確保不中斷供應是監管機構、立法者、醫療提供者和產業界的共同使命。
blocks.en: Patient protection: ensuring uninterrupted supply is a shared mission of regulators, legislators, healthcare providers, and industry.

blocks.zh: 風險驅動的努力強度：風險越高 → 嚴謹度與跨職能協作程度也應相應提升。
blocks.en: Risk-driven level of effort: the higher the risk, the greater the rigor and cross-functional collaboration should be.

blocks.zh: 主動溝通：與衛生當局及所有利害關係人的有效即時溝通，是防止短缺的核心機制。
blocks.en: Proactive communication: effective, timely communication with health authorities and all stakeholders is the core mechanism for preventing shortages.

blocks.zh: TR-68 提供的三個工具
blocks.en: The Three Tools Provided by TR-68

blocks.zh: 風險分流模型（Triage Model）— 評估短缺風險等級
blocks.en: Triage Model: assesses the shortage risk level

blocks.zh: 風險登記表模板（Risk Register）— 產品層級的系統化記錄
blocks.en: Risk Register template: systematic product-level documentation

blocks.zh: 預防與應對計畫模板（Prevention & Response Plan）— 事前準備 + 事後應對
blocks.en: Prevention & Response Plan template: preparation beforehand + response afterward

blocks.zh: 此外，報告強調透過 PAC 管理計畫（PAC Management Plans）與協調統一的 gCPs（優良持續改善規範），加快多個衛生當局的審查速度，以降低設施老化、製程更新的短缺風險。
blocks.en: In addition, the report stresses that PAC Management Plans and harmonized gCPs (good change practices) speed up review across multiple health authorities, reducing shortage risk from aging facilities and process updates.

blocks.zh: TR-68 全報告架構綜合圖解 — Key Learning Synthesis
blocks.en: TR-68 Overall Structure Diagram: Key Learning Synthesis

blocks.zh: 本框整合 TR-68 全部章節，呈現從識別短缺根本原因到系統管控的完整工作流程。
blocks.en: This diagram integrates all TR-68 sections and shows the complete workflow from identifying the root causes of shortages to systematic control.

blocks.zh: 根本原因識別（Sections 1–3）
blocks.en: Root Cause Identification (Sections 1-3)

blocks.zh: 製造問題、商業問題、經濟地理問題、可靠性問題 → 了解短缺的四大驅動力；建立對 PAC 審批延遲、設施老化、供應鏈單一來源等問題的認識。
blocks.en: Manufacturing issues, commercial issues, economic and geographic issues, and reliability issues: understand the four drivers of shortages, and build awareness of problems such as PAC approval delays, aging facilities, and single sourcing in the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 風險分流模型（Triage Model）（Section 4 / Appendix 2-B/C）
blocks.en: Triage Model (Section 4 / Appendix 2-B/C)

blocks.zh: 評估患者影響（Risk Level A/B/C）× 短缺可能性（High/Medium/Low）= Risk Priority Level 1/2/3。此步驟決定後續資源投入程度。
blocks.en: Assess patient impact (Risk Level A/B/C) × likelihood of shortage (High/Medium/Low) = Risk Priority Level 1/2/3. This step determines the level of resources invested afterward.

blocks.zh: 風險登記表（Risk Register）（Section 5 / Appendix 1）
blocks.en: Risk Register (Section 5 / Appendix 1)

blocks.zh: 將已識別的短缺風險結構化記錄：風險描述 → 初始風險等級 → 計畫控制措施 → 緩解後風險等級 → 責任人 → 完成期限。提供可追溯的管理紀錄。
blocks.en: Record identified shortage risks in a structured way: risk description → initial risk level → planned control measures → risk level after mitigation → owner → completion deadline. This provides a traceable management record.

blocks.zh: 預防計畫（Prevention Plan）（Section 6 / Appendix 2-D）
blocks.en: Prevention Plan (Section 6 / Appendix 2-D)

blocks.zh: 依優先等級建立控制措施：Priority 1 需最嚴格的預防行動（雙重供應來源、庫存緩衝、PAC 快速通道申請）；Priority 3 可接受較基本的一般管控。
blocks.en: Establish control measures by priority level: Priority 1 requires the strictest preventive actions (dual sourcing, inventory buffers, PAC fast-track applications); Priority 3 can accept more basic, general controls.

blocks.zh: 應對計畫（Response Plan）（Section 7 / Appendix 2-E）
blocks.en: Response Plan (Section 7 / Appendix 2-E)

blocks.zh: 短缺發生後啟動：確認原因 → 評估患者影響 → 短期行動計畫 → 溝通計畫（Dear HCP Letters / Patient Letters）→ 長期恢復計畫。
blocks.en: Activated when a shortage occurs: confirm the cause → assess patient impact → short-term action plan → communication plan (Dear HCP Letters / Patient Letters) → long-term recovery plan.

blocks.zh: 利害關係人溝通（Stakeholder Communication）（Section 8）
blocks.en: Stakeholder Communication (Section 8)

blocks.zh: 與衛生當局主動溝通（AESPG/EFPIA/EGA/PPTA 原則）：事前分享資訊 → PAC 加速申請 → 短缺通報（EMA MAH 指引 / FDA 21 USC 356c）→ 後續更新。
blocks.en: Communicate proactively with health authorities (AESPG/EFPIA/EGA/PPTA principles): share information in advance → PAC expedited applications → shortage notification (EMA MAH guidance / FDA 21 USC 356c) → follow-up updates.

blocks.zh: 計畫審查與更新（Review & Update）（Appendix 2-F）
blocks.en: Review & Update (Appendix 2-F)

blocks.zh: 觸發條件驅動定期複審：新適應症、新市場批准、替代品短缺、設施停產等 → 確保計畫始終反映最新風險狀況。
blocks.en: Periodic review driven by trigger conditions: new indication, new market approval, shortage of an alternative product, facility shutdown, and so on, ensuring the plan always reflects the latest risk situation.

blocks.zh: 10.0 References | 參考文獻
blocks.en: 10.0 References

blocks.zh: 51 項參考文獻 • 涵蓋 ICH、FDA、EMA、Health Canada、PDA 及產業研究 • p40–p43
blocks.en: 51 references • covering ICH, FDA, EMA, Health Canada, PDA, and industry research • p40-p43

blocks.zh: 參考文獻解析
blocks.en: Commentary on the References

blocks.zh: 最關鍵的 ICH 指引三角：Q9(R1)、Q10、Q12
blocks.en: The Most Critical ICH Triangle: Q9(R1), Q10, Q12

blocks.zh: ICH Q9(R1) — 品質風險管理（2023）：TR-68 的理論基礎。提供 FMEA、危害分析等工具，並新增「嚴重性」（Severity）作為主要風險因子，強調以患者為中心的風險決策。TR-68 的 Triage Model 直接應用 Q9(R1) 的風險評估原則。
blocks.en: ICH Q9(R1) - Quality Risk Management (2023): the theoretical foundation of TR-68. It provides tools such as FMEA and hazard analysis, and adds "Severity" as a primary risk factor, emphasizing patient-centered risk decisions. The TR-68 Triage Model directly applies the Q9(R1) risk assessment principles.

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 — 製藥品質系統（2008）：定義 PQS 四大元素，其中「產品實現」（Product Realization）和「改進的監控與持續改進」（Monitoring and Continual Improvement）為 TR-68 Risk Register 的制度性基礎。短缺管理應嵌入 PQS 而非獨立運作。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 - Pharmaceutical Quality System (2008): defines the four PQS elements, of which "Product Realization" and "Monitoring and Continual Improvement" are the systemic basis of the TR-68 Risk Register. Shortage management should be embedded in the PQS rather than operate independently.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 — 產品生命週期管理（2019）：提供 PAC 管理工具，包括 PACMP（Post-Approval Change Management Protocol），這是 TR-68 中「加速 PAC 審批以降低短缺風險」的核心監管路徑。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 - Product Lifecycle Management (2019): provides PAC management tools, including the PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol), which is the core regulatory pathway for "expediting PAC approval to reduce shortage risk" in TR-68.

blocks.zh: 比喻：參考文獻是建築材料清單
blocks.en: Analogy: The References Are a Bill of Materials

blocks.zh: 如果 TR-68 是一棟建築，那麼 ICH Q9(R1) 是地基（風險方法論），Q10 是承重結構（品質系統），Q12 是門窗設計（變更管理路徑），FDA 21 USC 356c 和 EMA MAH 短缺通報指引是消防安全法規（強制合規要求）。了解每份引用文獻的角色，才能理解 TR-68 架構的完整性。
blocks.en: If TR-68 is a building, ICH Q9(R1) is the foundation (risk methodology), Q10 is the load-bearing structure (quality system), Q12 is the door and window design (change management pathway), and FDA 21 USC 356c and the EMA MAH shortage notification guidance are the fire safety codes (mandatory compliance requirements). Understanding the role of each cited reference is how you understand the completeness of the TR-68 structure.

blocks.zh: 自我測試：配對練習
blocks.en: Self-Test: Matching Exercise

blocks.zh: 請將以下情境與最相關的 TR-68 參考文獻配對：
blocks.en: Match each scenario below to the most relevant TR-68 reference:

blocks.zh: 製造商需要向 FDA 通報即將發生的短缺 → 參考 Ref #18（21 USC 356c）
blocks.en: A manufacturer needs to notify the FDA of an upcoming shortage → see Ref #18 (21 USC 356c)

blocks.zh: EMA 授權的藥品發生短缺，MAH 需了解通報流程 → 參考 Ref #21（EMA MAH Guidance 2019）
blocks.en: A product authorized by the EMA is in shortage, and the MAH needs to understand the notification process → see Ref #21 (EMA MAH Guidance 2019)

blocks.zh: 公司希望透過 PACMP 加速 API 來源變更審批 → 參考 Ref #48（ICH Q12）
blocks.en: A company wants to use a PACMP to expedite approval of an API source change → see Ref #48 (ICH Q12)

blocks.zh: 需要建立系統性品質風險評估方法 → 參考 Ref #1（ICH Q9(R1)）
blocks.en: A systematic quality risk assessment method needs to be established → see Ref #1 (ICH Q9(R1))

blocks.zh: 11.0 Appendix 1 — Drug Shortage Risk Register Template | 藥品短缺風險登記表
blocks.en: 11.0 Appendix 1 - Drug Shortage Risk Register Template

blocks.zh: 結構化記錄短缺風險的標準模板 • p44
blocks.en: Standard Template for Structured Recording of Shortage Risks • p44

blocks.zh: 如何填寫風險登記表 — CDMO 實務範例
blocks.en: How to Complete the Risk Register: A CDMO Practical Example

blocks.zh: 情境設定：單一來源 API 的關鍵注射劑
blocks.en: Scenario: A Critical Injectable with a Single-Source API

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家 CDMO，生產某 MAH 的單一來源抗癌注射劑（無替代品，生命維持用途）。你的 API 供應商位於同一地區，供應鏈集中風險高。
blocks.en: Suppose you are a CDMO manufacturing a single-source anticancer injectable for an MAH (no alternative, life-sustaining use). Your API supplier is located in the same region, so supply chain concentration risk is high.

blocks.zh: 風險登記表的三個關鍵設計邏輯
blocks.en: Three Key Design Principles of the Risk Register

blocks.zh: 「報紙標題式」風險描述：逼使填寫者思清楚「如果明天頭版是這個產品的短缺新聞，標題會是什麼？」這種表達方式確保風險描述具體、有緊迫感。
blocks.en: "Newspaper headline" risk description: forces the author to think clearly about "if tomorrow's front page is news of a shortage of this product, what would the headline be?" This style ensures the risk description is specific and conveys urgency.

blocks.zh: 先行與落後指標並列：先行指標（leading indicators）用於早期預警（庫存水位、供應商稽核結果）；落後指標（lagging indicators）用於驗證管控效果（批次拒絕率）。兩者並用才能形成完整監控機制。
blocks.en: Leading and lagging indicators side by side: leading indicators are used for early warning (stock levels, supplier audit results); lagging indicators are used to verify the effectiveness of controls (batch rejection rate). Using both forms a complete monitoring mechanism.

blocks.zh: 前後風險等級對比：記錄「Initial Risk Level」與「Risk Level After Control」，直接量化管控措施的有效性，也為管理層審查提供清晰的決策依據。
blocks.en: Comparison of risk levels before and after controls: recording the "Initial Risk Level" and the "Risk Level After Control" directly quantifies the effectiveness of the control measures and gives management review a clear basis for decisions.

blocks.zh: CDMO 思考練習
blocks.en: CDMO Exercise

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 目前有幾個產品符合以下特徵，需要被列入 Risk Register？
blocks.en: Which of your CDMO's products currently have the following characteristics and need to be included in the Risk Register?

blocks.zh: 僅有單一 API 供應商，且未進行備用來源認證
blocks.en: Only a single API supplier, with no qualified backup source

blocks.zh: 生產設備為客製化特殊設備，備件取得困難
blocks.en: Production equipment is custom-built specialty equipment, and spare parts are hard to obtain

blocks.zh: 產品無市場替代品，屬生命維持或支持性用途
blocks.en: The product has no alternative on the market and is for life-sustaining or supportive use

blocks.zh: 安全庫存低於 60 天，且需求預測準確性不足
blocks.en: Safety stock is below 60 days, and demand forecast accuracy is insufficient

blocks.zh: 建議：先從 Priority 1 產品開始建立 Risk Register，再逐步擴大至 Priority 2、3。
blocks.en: Recommendation: start by building the Risk Register for Priority 1 products, then expand gradually to Priority 2 and 3.

blocks.zh: 12.0 Appendix 2 — Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan Template | 藥品短缺預防與應對計畫
blocks.en: 12.0 Appendix 2 - Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan Template

blocks.zh: 七大組成部分（A–G）• 風險分流 + 控制措施 + 溝通計畫 • p45–p48
blocks.en: Seven Components (A-G) • Risk Triage + Control Measures + Communication Plan • p45-p48

blocks.zh: 比喻：預防與應對計畫如同緊急應變手冊
blocks.en: Analogy: The Prevention and Response Plan Is Like an Emergency Response Manual

blocks.zh: 預防與應對計畫就像醫院的緊急疏散手冊——你希望永遠不需要使用它，但一旦需要，它必須已在架上、完整且最新。沒有這份計畫時發生短缺，組織將處於被動應對的混亂狀態；有了這份計畫，所有人知道自己的角色和時間線，患者的傷害可以被最小化。
blocks.en: The Prevention and Response Plan is like a hospital's emergency evacuation manual: you hope never to need it, but when you do, it must already be on the shelf, complete, and up to date. If a shortage occurs without this plan, the organization is left in the chaos of reactive response; with the plan, everyone knows their role and timeline, and harm to patients can be minimized.

blocks.zh: TR-68 的七個部分（A–G）正是這本「緊急應變手冊」的完整章節架構：從產品基本資料（A）→ 患者影響評估（B）→ 優先等級（C）→ 預防措施（D）→ 應對措施（E）→ 審查觸發條件（F）→ 批准簽署（G）。
blocks.en: The seven parts (A-G) of TR-68 are the complete chapter structure of this "emergency response manual": from basic product data (A) → patient impact assessment (B) → priority level (C) → preventive measures (D) → response measures (E) → review triggers (F) → approval and sign-off (G).

blocks.zh: Part A — Basic Data | 基本資料
blocks.en: Part A - Basic Data

blocks.zh: [填寫 API 通用名稱]
blocks.en: [Enter API generic name]

blocks.zh: [商品名/通用名]
blocks.en: [Brand name / generic name]

blocks.zh: [劑型與規格，如 50mg/mL Injection]
blocks.en: [Dosage form and strength, e.g., 50 mg/mL Injection]

blocks.zh: [解剖學-治療學-化學分類碼]
blocks.en: [Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code]

blocks.zh: [包裝規格]
blocks.en: [Pack size]

blocks.zh: [治療適應症]
blocks.en: [Therapeutic indication]

blocks.zh: [給藥途徑]
blocks.en: [Route of administration]

blocks.zh: [負責人姓名、電話、Email]
blocks.en: [Responsible person's name, phone, email]

blocks.zh: [如：上市國家、MAA 編號、預計結束日期]
blocks.en: [e.g., countries where marketed, MAA number, expected end date]

blocks.zh: Part A 填寫要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Completing Part A

blocks.zh: Part A 是計畫的「身份證」。ATC Code（解剖學-治療學-化學分類碼）特別重要，因為：
blocks.en: Part A is the plan's "identity card". The ATC Code (Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code) is especially important because:

blocks.zh: 同一 ATC 碼下的產品互為替代品 → 直接影響 Part B 的「可替代性」評估
blocks.en: Products under the same ATC code are substitutes for one another → this directly affects the "substitutability" assessment in Part B

blocks.zh: EMA 的藥品短缺資料庫以 ATC 碼分類 → 便於衛生當局快速識別影響範圍
blocks.en: The EMA's drug shortage database is organized by ATC code → this lets health authorities quickly identify the scope of impact

blocks.zh: 其他資訊欄位在應對計畫（Response Plan）啟動時需填入：受影響國家、預計短缺結束日期
blocks.en: The other information fields are to be filled in when the Response Plan is activated: affected countries and expected end date of the shortage

blocks.zh: Part B — Impact to Patient | 患者影響評估（Risk Level A/B/C）
blocks.en: Part B - Impact to Patient (Risk Level A/B/C)

blocks.zh: Risk Level 判斷邏輯
blocks.en: Logic for Determining Risk Level

blocks.zh: Part B 的核心是患者影響的二維矩陣：治療用途（嚴重性） × 替代品可用性。
blocks.en: The core of Part B is a two-dimensional matrix of patient impact: therapeutic use (severity) × availability of alternatives.

blocks.zh: 三個 Risk Level 的實務含義
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of the Three Risk Levels

blocks.zh: Risk Level A：最高患者風險 → 需要最嚴格的管控，任何短跡象都需立即上報衛生當局。典型範例：新生兒腸外營養液、胰島素、抗癌化療藥。
blocks.en: Risk Level A: highest patient risk → requires the strictest controls, and any sign of a shortage must be reported to the health authority immediately. Typical examples: neonatal parenteral nutrition solutions, insulin, anticancer chemotherapy drugs.

blocks.zh: Risk Level B：中等患者風險 → 需要強化管控但可有一定緩衝期。典型範例：具有可替代品的慢性病用藥（有其他廠牌可用的降壓藥）。
blocks.en: Risk Level B: moderate patient risk → requires enhanced controls but allows some buffer time. Typical examples: chronic disease drugs with alternatives (e.g., antihypertensives for which other brands are available).

blocks.zh: Risk Level C：較低患者風險 → 標準管控即可。典型範例：非處方止痛藥、便秘藥等，有多種替代選項。
blocks.en: Risk Level C: lower patient risk → standard controls are sufficient. Typical examples: over-the-counter analgesics and laxatives, for which multiple alternatives exist.

blocks.zh: 注意：即使是 Risk Level C，仍需完成 Part D 的預防計畫，只是控制措施的嚴格程度較低。
blocks.en: Note: even for Risk Level C, the Part D prevention plan must still be completed; the control measures are simply less stringent.

blocks.zh: Part C — Risk Priority Level | 風險優先等級（1/2/3）
blocks.en: Part C - Risk Priority Level (1/2/3)

blocks.zh: 優先等級的管理意涵
blocks.en: Management Implications of the Priority Level

blocks.zh: Part C 是資源分配決策矩陣
blocks.en: Part C Is a Resource Allocation Decision Matrix

blocks.zh: Risk Priority Level 決定了公司需要投入多少資源進行管控。這個邏輯與 ICH Q9(R1) 的「風險決策原則」一致：風險等級越高，需要投入越多的驗證、監控和緩解措施。
blocks.en: The Risk Priority Level determines how much resource the company must invest in control. This logic is consistent with the "risk-based decision principles" of ICH Q9(R1): the higher the risk level, the more validation, monitoring, and mitigation is needed.

blocks.zh: Priority 1：最高優先 — 需要主動的預防措施（雙重來源、高安全庫存、PAC 備案）+ 主動與衛生當局溝通
blocks.en: Priority 1: highest priority → requires proactive preventive measures (dual sourcing, high safety stock, PAC filings) + proactive communication with health authorities

blocks.zh: Priority 2：中等優先 — 需要監控機制和應急計畫，定期複審
blocks.en: Priority 2: medium priority → requires monitoring mechanisms and contingency plans, with periodic review

blocks.zh: Priority 3：一般優先 — 標準品質系統管控，納入年度風險審查
blocks.en: Priority 3: general priority → standard quality system controls, included in the annual risk review

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：即使是 Risk Level A 的產品，如果短缺可能性低（有多重預防措施），Priority 也可以是 2 而非 1 — 這鼓勵公司主動建立防護措施以降低優先等級。
blocks.en: Key insight: even for a Risk Level A product, if the likelihood of shortage is low (because of multiple preventive measures), the Priority can be 2 rather than 1. This encourages companies to proactively put safeguards in place to lower the priority level.

blocks.zh: Part D — Risk Control Activities for Proactive Prevention | 主動預防措施
blocks.en: Part D - Risk Control Activities for Proactive Prevention

blocks.zh: CDMO 預防措施實施清單
blocks.en: CDMO Preventive Measures Implementation Checklist

blocks.zh: Priority 1 — CDMO 必備防線
blocks.en: Priority 1: Essential CDMO Lines of Defense

blocks.zh: 雙重 API 供應商認證（含 RA 備案準備）
blocks.en: Qualify dual API suppliers (including RA filing preparation)

blocks.zh: 安全庫存目標：至少 180 天（原物料 + 半成品 + 成品）
blocks.en: Safety stock target: at least 180 days (raw materials + intermediates + finished product)

blocks.zh: PACMP（ICH Q12）準備：預先獲得衛生當局認可的變更管理協議
blocks.en: PACMP (ICH Q12) preparation: a change management protocol agreed in advance with the health authority

blocks.zh: 每季供應鏈風險評估報告
blocks.en: Quarterly supply chain risk assessment report

blocks.zh: 與 MAH 建立早期預警通報機制（Leading Indicator 達警戒線即通報）
blocks.en: Establish an early warning notification mechanism with the MAH (notify when a leading indicator reaches its alert limit)

blocks.zh: 廠房設備備件管理計畫（關鍵設備備用零件庫存）
blocks.en: Facility and equipment spare parts management plan (spare parts inventory for critical equipment)

blocks.zh: Priority 2/3 — CDMO 基線管控
blocks.en: Priority 2/3: CDMO Baseline Controls

blocks.zh: 供應商資格評估（QAA 協議覆蓋所有關鍵供應商）
blocks.en: Supplier qualification assessment (QAA covering all critical suppliers)

blocks.zh: 庫存水位月報追蹤
blocks.en: Monthly tracking report of inventory levels

blocks.zh: 產能使用率監控（避免長期超過 85% 警戒線）
blocks.en: Capacity utilization monitoring (avoid staying above the 85% alert line for long periods)

blocks.zh: 年度藥品短缺風險登記表複審
blocks.en: Annual review of the Drug Shortage Risk Register

blocks.zh: Part E — Drug Shortage Response Plan | 短缺應對計畫（五個步驟）
blocks.en: Part E - Drug Shortage Response Plan (Five Steps)

blocks.zh: 應對計畫的五步驟解析
blocks.en: The Five Steps of the Response Plan Explained

blocks.zh: Step 1 — 四大根本原因類別的診斷意義
blocks.en: Step 1: The Diagnostic Significance of the Four Root Cause Categories

blocks.zh: 四大根本原因類別（製造、商業、經濟地理、可靠性）直接對應 TR-68 Section 3 的短缺根本原因分析。診斷正確才能選擇正確的應對措施：製造問題需要 CAPA；商業問題需要供應鏈重組；法規問題需要 RA 策略；疫情等多方利害關係人問題需要跨部門協作。
blocks.en: The four root cause categories (manufacturing, commercial, economic and geographic, reliability) correspond directly to the shortage root cause analysis in TR-68 Section 3. Only a correct diagnosis leads to the correct response: manufacturing problems need CAPA; commercial problems need supply chain restructuring; regulatory problems need an RA strategy; and multi-stakeholder problems such as pandemics need cross-functional collaboration.

blocks.zh: Step 4 — 溝通計畫的三層受眾
blocks.en: Step 4: The Three Audience Tiers of the Communication Plan

blocks.zh: 衛生當局：正式短缺通報（FDA 21 USC 356c / EMA MAH 指引）；包含預估持續時間、受影響批次
blocks.en: Health authorities: formal shortage notification (FDA 21 USC 356c / EMA MAH guidance); includes the estimated duration and affected batches

blocks.zh: 醫療提供者：Dear Health Care Provider Letter；提供替代療法資訊、用藥管理建議
blocks.en: Healthcare providers: Dear Health Care Provider Letter; provides information on alternative therapies and medication management advice

blocks.zh: 患者：Patient Letter 或知情同意書更新；說明短缺原因、預期解決時間、可採取的行動
blocks.en: Patients: Patient Letter or updated informed consent; explains the cause of the shortage, the expected resolution time, and actions patients can take

blocks.zh: CDMO 角色定位練習
blocks.en: Exercise: Defining the CDMO's Role

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，短缺應對計畫中你的責任邊界是什麼？
blocks.en: As a CDMO, where are your responsibility boundaries in the shortage response plan?

blocks.zh: CDMO 主責：Step 1（製造問題診斷）、Step 3（短期製造恢復計畫）、Step 5（長期產能恢復時程）
blocks.en: CDMO leads: Step 1 (manufacturing problem diagnosis), Step 3 (short-term manufacturing recovery plan), Step 5 (long-term capacity recovery timeline)

blocks.zh: MAH 主責：Step 2（患者風險評估）、Step 4（患者/HCP 溝通）、衛生當局正式通報
blocks.en: MAH leads: Step 2 (patient risk assessment), Step 4 (patient/HCP communication), formal notification to health authorities

blocks.zh: 共同責任：應對計畫制定、信息共享、時程協調
blocks.en: Shared responsibility: developing the response plan, information sharing, timeline coordination

blocks.zh: 在簽訂的 Quality Technical Agreement（QTA）中，應預先明確這些責任邊界。
blocks.en: These responsibility boundaries should be clearly defined in advance in the signed Quality Technical Agreement (QTA).

blocks.zh: Part F & G — Risk Review Triggers & Approvals | 審查觸發條件與批准
blocks.en: Part F & G - Risk Review Triggers & Approvals

blocks.zh: Part F/G 實務解析
blocks.en: Practical Commentary on Part F/G

blocks.zh: 觸發條件的管理邏輯
blocks.en: The Management Logic of Trigger Conditions

blocks.zh: Part F 的觸發條件清單體現了 TR-68 的核心理念：藥品短缺計畫不是一次性文件，而是動態管理工具。任何改變產品供應-需求平衡的事件，都應觸發計畫的重新評估。
blocks.en: The list of trigger conditions in Part F reflects the core philosophy of TR-68: a drug shortage plan is not a one-time document but a dynamic management tool. Any event that changes the supply-demand balance of the product should trigger a reassessment of the plan.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 特別重要的觸發條件：
blocks.en: Trigger conditions of particular importance to a CDMO:

blocks.zh: GMP 憑證撤銷：一旦供應商或自身的 GMP 認證受到撤銷威脅，立即升級至最高應對狀態
blocks.en: GMP certificate withdrawal: once a supplier's or the CDMO's own GMP certification is under threat of withdrawal, escalate immediately to the highest response status

blocks.zh: 庫存低於安全水位：這是最常見的預警觸發條件，需在 ERP 系統中設置自動警報
blocks.en: Inventory below the safety level: this is the most common early warning trigger and requires an automatic alert to be set up in the ERP system

blocks.zh: 替代品短缺：市場上其他廠牌的同類產品發生短缺，可能導致本產品需求急速上升
blocks.en: Shortage of an alternative product: a shortage of a similar product from another brand on the market may cause demand for this product to rise sharply

blocks.zh: Part G — 批准矩陣的合規意義
blocks.en: Part G - Compliance Significance of the Approval Matrix

blocks.zh: 三級批准（負責人 + QA 決策者 + 高級管理層）確保短缺防範計畫獲得組織最高層級的正式背書。這符合 ICH Q10 對管理責任的要求，也是稽核時展示管理承諾的重要文件。
blocks.en: Three-level approval (responsible person + QA decision-maker + senior management) ensures that the shortage prevention plan receives formal endorsement at the highest level of the organization. This is consistent with the ICH Q10 requirements for management responsibility and is an important document for demonstrating management commitment during audits.

blocks.zh: 建議：將藥品短缺防範計畫的年度複審納入管理層審查（Management Review）議程，與品質系統其他關鍵指標一同審視。
blocks.en: Recommendation: include the annual review of the drug shortage prevention plan on the Management Review agenda, alongside the other key indicators of the quality system.

blocks.zh: CDMO 競爭差異化應用：以 TR-68 贏得 MAH 信任
blocks.en: CDMO Competitive Differentiation: Winning MAH Trust with TR-68

blocks.zh: TR-68 不只是合規工具，對 CDMO 而言，主動落實 TR-68 是向 MAH 展示供應可靠性的強力競爭差異化手段。以下是實際應用策略：
blocks.en: TR-68 is not only a compliance tool; for a CDMO, proactively implementing TR-68 is a powerful competitive differentiator for demonstrating supply reliability to the MAH. The following are practical application strategies:

blocks.zh: 核心競爭優勢論述：在 CDMO 資格評估時，主動向 MAH 展示「我們已為每一個合作產品建立了符合 TR-68 的短缺防範計畫」，這比任何行銷材料都更有說服力——因為它直接回應了 MAH 對供應鏈可靠性的核心顧慮。
blocks.en: Core competitive advantage argument: during CDMO qualification, proactively show the MAH that "we have established a TR-68-compliant shortage prevention plan for every product we work on together". This is more persuasive than any marketing material, because it directly addresses the MAH's core concern about supply chain reliability.

blocks.zh: Section 5 學習總結 — TR-68 完整框架的最終整合
blocks.en: Section 5 Learning Summary: Final Integration of the Complete TR-68 Framework

blocks.zh: 本節是 TR-68 的終章，提供了可直接應用的工具模板（附錄一、二）並透過結論串聯全報告的核心訊息。
blocks.en: This section is the final chapter of TR-68. It provides ready-to-use tool templates (Appendices 1 and 2) and ties together the core messages of the whole report through the conclusions.

blocks.zh: 9.0 結論呼應了 TR-68 的三大基石：患者保護、風險驅動的努力強度、以及跨組織的主動溝通。這不僅是技術報告的總結，更是整個藥品供應鏈生態系（監管機構、製造商、MAH、CDMO）共同使命的宣示。
blocks.en: 9.0 Conclusions echo the three cornerstones of TR-68: patient protection, risk-driven level of effort, and proactive cross-organizational communication. This is not only a summary of the technical report but also a declaration of the shared mission of the entire drug supply chain ecosystem (regulators, manufacturers, MAHs, CDMOs).

blocks.zh: 10.0 參考文獻中最重要的三角關係是 ICH Q9(R1)（風險方法論）+ Q10（品質系統整合）+ Q12（生命週期變更管理），三者共同支撐 TR-68 的全部管控建議。
blocks.en: 10.0 References: the most important triangular relationship is ICH Q9(R1) (risk methodology) + Q10 (quality system integration) + Q12 (lifecycle change management), which together support all of the control recommendations in TR-68.

blocks.zh: 11.0 附錄一（Risk Register）的關鍵設計是「報紙標題式」的風險描述 + 先行/落後指標並列 + 前後風險等級對比，三者確保 Risk Register 是活的管理工具而非靜態文件。
blocks.en: 11.0 Appendix 1 (Risk Register): its key design features are the "newspaper headline" risk description, leading and lagging indicators side by side, and comparison of risk levels before and after controls; together these ensure the Risk Register is a living management tool rather than a static document.

blocks.zh: 12.0 附錄二（Prevention & Response Plan）是七部分的完整框架：A（基本資料）→ B（患者影響，A/B/C）→ C（優先等級，1/2/3）→ D（預防措施）→ E（五步驟應對）→ F（複審觸發條件）→ G（管理層批准）。
blocks.en: 12.0 Appendix 2 (Prevention & Response Plan) is a complete seven-part framework: A (basic data) → B (patient impact, A/B/C) → C (priority level, 1/2/3) → D (preventive measures) → E (five-step response) → F (review triggers) → G (management approval).

blocks.zh: CDMO 的核心啟示：TR-68 提供的三個工具（Triage Model + Risk Register + Prevention & Response Plan）可以被 CDMO 主動包裝為「供應可靠性保證」的組成部分，在 RFP 回覆、品質技術協議、年度商業審查中展示，建立與 MAH 的長期信任關係。
blocks.en: Key takeaway for the CDMO: the three tools provided by TR-68 (Triage Model + Risk Register + Prevention & Response Plan) can be proactively packaged by the CDMO as part of a "supply reliability assurance" and presented in RFP responses, quality technical agreements, and annual business reviews to build long-term trust with the MAH.
